info.headline: Notify NYC - CERT Exercise - Cadman Plaza East - 10/27 & 10/28 (BK)
info.description:
Notification issued 10-26-2026 at 03:00 PM.
As part of a Community Emergency Response Team (CERT) training class, a fire safety exercise will be conducted from approximately 6:30 PM - 9:30 PM on 10/27 & 10/28 in the area of Cadman Plaza East and Red Cross Place in Brooklyn. Expect to see FDNY and NYPD personnel in action. To learn more about CERT, visit http://www.NYC.gov/CERT.
